tests.name: Booking produces exactly one simulated SMS invitation when no active chat
Planning calendar opens the exact appointment and shows its details
Automatic MAX reminders are blocked without consent and active chat
MAX chat requires consent, activates on simulated consent, records only educational message
Three reminders run at 10, 12, 14 hours without duplicates
At 15:30 unanswered booking creates one CRM call task with calendar link
Withdrawal of consent blocks employee messages again
Booking with an active MAX chat creates chat notice, not SMS invitation
Calendar filtering by date and previous/next buttons actually works
